title: Google 2FA regional redirects and background WebView notifications
what: Allow all regional Google domains (*.google.co.ve, etc.) and non-gesture redirects in WebView, retain WebView in WebViewHost with silent dataSync Foreground Service, and bridge Notification + ServiceWorkerRegistration.showNotification + Permissions API.
why: Google 2FA CheckCookie bounces through country Google domains and Android suspends background WebViews unless kept alive by a Foreground Service.
learned: Use monochrome vector ic_stat_antigravity for smallIcon, inject bridge on onPageStarted/onPageFinished, and never call webView.destroy() on backgrounding.
author: reactive-end
